verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at sandbox0.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary. They also confirm that docs pages are served as raw markdown (e.g. /docs/sandbox.md), and many doc citations come from .md endpoints, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit first-party guidance on using these docs with agents, and no independent user reports of agents consuming them.
